# GrowLokal AI

> Autonomous AI Local Marketing Platform for South Indian Small & Medium Businesses

GrowLokal (https://growlokal.com) is an enterprise-grade AI marketing platform built specifically for local businesses across South India (Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Coimbatore, Kochi, Madurai).

## Core Capabilities
- **Google Business Profile Autopilot**: Automatically optimizes Google Maps rankings, publishes weekly localized updates, and drafts professional review responses in seconds.
- **Vernacular AI Engine**: Native AI content generation and customer communication in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and English.
- **WhatsApp 24/7 Lead Responder**: AI chatbot that captures customer inquiries, qualifies leads, and schedules appointments automatically.
- **Multi-Platform Integration**: Seamlessly syncs with Google Maps, Google Search, WhatsApp Meta Business, Instagram Business, and Facebook Pages.
